text:
Modern teams need to collaborate on projects in real-time. A simple to-do list
doesn't work when multiple people are involved.
Your mission: Build "TaskSync", a multi-user project management platform. Users
can create projects, invite other registered users to join them, create tasks within
those projects, assign tasks to specific team members, and move them through a
workflow (To Do ➔ In Progress ➔ Done).
This requires strict security: a user should never be able to view or edit a project
they haven't been invited to.

Backend Architecture: Node.js, Express.js (Strict MVC or
Controller/Service/Route architecture).
Security:
bcrypt , jsonwebtoken (HttpOnly Cookies), plus custom Authorization
Middlewares.
Database: PostgreSQL ( pg pool).
Frontend: Vanilla HTML, CSS, JavaScript (SPA - Single Page Application
architecture using the Fetch API).

Your PostgreSQL database must implement the following tables. Notice the Many-
to-Many relationship between Users and Projects.

id (PK), name , description , owner_id (FK to users.id ).

1.Phase 1: DB Schema & Auth Middlewares:
Create your tables. Write your JWT authentication middleware. Then, write your
Project Authorization middleware. This middleware needs to look at req.params.id
(the project ID), query the database, and verify req.user.id is in the project_members
table before calling next() .
2.Phase 2: Database Transactions:
When a user hits POST /api/projects , you must do two things: INSERT into projects ,
then INSERT into project_members . If the second query fails, the first one must be
undone. Research and implement PostgreSQL Transactions ( BEGIN , COMMIT ,
ROLLBACK ) in your controller.
3.Phase 3: The Complex SQL JOINs:
Write the GET /api/projects route. You cannot just select from projects . You must
write a query that joins projects and project_members to return only the workspaces
the logged-in user has access to.
4.Phase 4: Frontend State & Routing:
